mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model_health_snapshot SET health_status = IF(#{success}, IF(health_status = 'UNHEALTHY', 'RECOVERING', 'HEALTHY'), IF(consecutive_failures + 1 >= #{failureThreshold}, 'UNHEALTHY', 'DEGRADED')), auth_status = IF(#{success}, 'PASSED', IF(#{authFailure}, 'FAILED', auth_status)), consecutive_failures = IF(#{success}, 0, consecutive_failures + 1), last_latency_ms = #{snapshot.lastLatencyMs}, last_error_category = #{snapshot.lastErrorCategory}, last_message = #{snapshot.lastMessage}, last_success_at = IF(#{success}, #{snapshot.lastSuccessAt}, last_success_at), last_failure_at = IF(#{success}, last_failure_at, #{snapshot.lastFailureAt}), next_probe_at = #{snapshot.nextProbeAt}, revision = revision + 1, last_probe_at = #{snapshot.lastProbeAt} WHERE model_config_id = #{snapshot.modelConfigId} AND tenant_id = #{snapshot.tenantId} AND last_probe_at < #{snapshot.lastProbeAt}
mapper.select: SELECT model.* FROM ai_model_config model LEFT JOIN ai_model_health_snapshot health ON health.model_config_id = model.id AND health.tenant_id = model.tenant_id WHERE model.deleted = 0 AND model.status = 1 AND model.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (health.next_probe_at IS NULL OR health.next_probe_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY COALESCE(health.next_probe_at, model.create_time), model.id LIMIT #{limit}
